records.name: nishijin
records.prompt: Create one landscape 16:9 production game asset: an illustrated overhead district map for an original Japanese post-apocalyptic strategy game, 西新世紀末物語. No interface, no lettering, no numbers, no mission pins, no star symbols, no people, no logo. This is a polished hand-painted cartographic illustration, not a screenshot, not a photo, not pixel art: precise ink contours, textured gouache roofs, restrained cel shading, readable clean forms. Orthographic overhead with only a shallow isometric tilt, no horizon. Entire frame is a believable Nishijin Japanese shopping district; a broad bent shopping street goes from bottom-left at (16%,70%), through a small pharmacy with a green cross canopy near (30%,48%), past a ward office courtyard near (45%,30%), toward a closed railway station with stopped tracks at (65%,40%), an empty platform at (77%,62%), and a dark underground rail entrance at (89%,76%). These are geographic landmarks, not UI symbols. Many varied small Japanese houses, tiled roofs, alleyways, awnings, small pocket parks, wrecked cars and rubble clustered at edges, modest warm orange window light. Keep roads as clear lighter grey surfaces with room to place live game markers over them. Calm dusty blue-green and slate palette, desaturated terracotta roofs, warm cream pavement and a few amber lamps. Ruined but structurally understandable, story-specific, restrained smoke, not a giant fiery city. Soft readable late-evening lighting; preserve midtones throughout rather than black shadows. Overhead whole neighborhood with 8% margins all sides. Rich detailed professional game concept-art quality, consistent scale, deliberate visual hierarchy. Do not copy any existing game map or intellectual property.
